fusions.name: Velvet Flick
fusions.desc: Throws a mesh that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 40% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 2 seconds. It has 30% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Toy with the Catch
fusions.desc: A raking swipe at a tangled target that deals 9 damage, leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds and [Bleeding] for 3 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Ropewalker
fusions.desc: Runs you along a conjured cord: you finish 2 tiles from where you stood, and your movement speed rises by 30% and your dodge chance by 10% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Caught Mid-Fall
fusions.desc: Once every 120 seconds, a blow that would kill you is caught instead and leaves you at 1 health.
